members.name: banking77
members.instructions: Which intent does this message from a customer of a digital bank's support chat express? Choose the single most specific intent. Pay attention to the exact subject (card payment vs cash withdrawal vs transfer vs top-up), and whether the customer asks how to do something, asks about a fee, or reports a problem.

criteria.activate_my_card: how to activate / start using a new card that has arrived (activation, 'card not yet active')
criteria.age_limit: minimum age to open an account / age requirements, can children or minors use it
criteria.apple_pay_or_google_pay: any question about Apple Pay or Google Pay / mobile wallets, adding the card to them, topping up with Apple Pay or Google Pay (including when it does not work)
criteria.atm_support: which ATMs can be used, finding an ATM, ATM locations or support in general (not a specific failed withdrawal)
criteria.automatic_top_up: setting up, enabling or disabling automatic / auto top-up of the account
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer: a bank transfer was made (e.g. from another/UK account) but the money or balance does not show up / is taking long to update in own account, or asking to check the account after a transfer was made, even when the customer also asks how long transfers take
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash: the customer deposited money (cash or cheque, or just 'deposited some money') and it still is not showing up in the balance
criteria.beneficiary_not_allowed: a transfer to a beneficiary/recipient is not allowed or was rejected because of the beneficiary; cannot transfer to own account / cannot add or use a beneficiary
criteria.cancel_transfer: wants to cancel or stop a transfer that was made, undo a payment/transfer
criteria.card_about_to_expire: card is expiring soon / expiry date, how to renew or get a replacement for an expiring card
criteria.card_acceptance: where the card is accepted, which merchants or places take the card
criteria.card_arrival: where is my card / it has not arrived yet, tracking a card that was ordered and is late or missing in the post
criteria.card_delivery_estimate: how long card delivery takes, expected delivery time or delivery options/express delivery for a card
criteria.card_linking: linking, connecting or adding an existing card to the app/account; making the app show a new card that arrived; re-linking a card
criteria.card_not_working: the card does not work / stopped working in general (not contactless, not virtual, not a specific declined payment)
criteria.card_payment_fee_charged: a fee was charged for paying by card / a card payment; why do payments have fees
criteria.card_payment_not_recognised: a card payment shown on the account that the customer did not make or does not recognise
criteria.card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate: wrong or bad exchange rate applied to a card payment abroad/in foreign currency
criteria.card_swallowed: the card was swallowed / kept / stuck in an ATM machine
criteria.cash_withdrawal_charge: a fee or charge for withdrawing cash, extra charge on a cash withdrawal
criteria.cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: a cash withdrawal or cash amount shown in the app/account that the customer did not make (e.g. 'cash balance showing that I did not receive'), unrecognised ATM withdrawal; NOT when the ATM gave the wrong amount
criteria.change_pin: how to change or set a PIN that the customer already has (not a PIN that never arrived)
criteria.compromised_card: the card details were compromised / fraud / hacked / someone used the card without permission (not simply lost or stolen)
criteria.country_support: which countries the service/account/card is available or supported in; can I get support / use the service in my country
criteria.declined_card_payment: a card payment was declined or rejected
criteria.declined_cash_withdrawal: a cash withdrawal at an ATM was declined or rejected
criteria.declined_transfer: a transfer was declined or rejected
criteria.direct_debit_payment_not_recognised: a direct debit payment the customer did not set up or does not recognise
criteria.disposable_card_limits: limits / restrictions / usage rules of disposable virtual cards
criteria.edit_personal_details: how to change or update personal details (name, address, phone, email, date of birth)
criteria.exchange_charge: fees or charges for exchanging currency
criteria.exchange_rate: what the exchange rate is / how exchange rates are determined (general question, no specific payment)
criteria.exchange_via_app: exchanging currency inside the app, which currencies are available for exchange in the app
criteria.extra_charge_on_statement: an unexpected extra / unknown charge or wrong amount on the statement (unspecified kind of charge)
criteria.failed_transfer: a transfer failed / did not go through
criteria.fiat_currency_support: which currencies the account supports / can hold or top up in ('what currencies do you support'); not about exchanging in the app
criteria.get_disposable_virtual_card: how to get or create a disposable virtual card
criteria.get_physical_card: how to get a physical card (general request), and also a PIN that has not been received / where is my PIN / how to get the PIN for the physical card
criteria.getting_spare_card: getting an additional or spare card, second card; how many cards one can have (limit on the number of cards); whether an extra/additional debit card is free
criteria.getting_virtual_card: how to get a (non-disposable) virtual card
criteria.lost_or_stolen_card: the card was lost or stolen; cannot find card
criteria.lost_or_stolen_phone: the phone was lost or stolen (worried about account/app access)
criteria.order_physical_card: wants to order a physical card, placing an order for a new card
criteria.passcode_forgotten: forgot the passcode / app password / login code
criteria.pending_card_payment: a card payment is pending / still shows as pending
criteria.pending_top_up: a top-up is pending / still processing, or not yet credited, cannot see the funds yet after topping up (the top-up did not disappear)
criteria.pending_transfer: a transfer or outgoing transaction shows as 'pending' / still processing in the app; a transfer that has been pending for a long time even though it finally worked out
criteria.pin_blocked: PIN is blocked, locked after wrong attempts, too many incorrect PIN entries
criteria.receiving_money: how to receive money / get paid into the account, incoming payments/deposits in general; being paid in a currency (e.g. GBP salary) and which currency the account is set to
criteria.Refund_not_showing_up: a refund that was promised/issued has not appeared in the account yet
criteria.request_refund: wants to request or get a refund for a payment or purchase, or cancel a purchase / return an item and get the money back
criteria.reverted_card_payment?: a card payment was reversed / cancelled / returned / reverted (payment cancelled by merchant, money returned); paid for something but the purchase/payment no longer shows
criteria.supported_cards_and_currencies: which cards AND currencies are supported together (e.g. which card types and currencies can be used to top up)
criteria.top_up_by_bank_transfer_charge: fees or charges when topping up by bank transfer
criteria.top_up_by_card_charge: fees or charges when topping up by card
criteria.top_up_by_cash_or_cheque: topping up with cash or a cheque, how to do so
criteria.top_up_failed: a top-up failed / was declined / gave an error / did not work; customer unsure if the top-up (also misspelt 'pop-up') went through
criteria.top_up_limits: limits on topping up (maximum or minimum amounts, how much can be topped up)
criteria.top_up_reverted: a top-up was reverted / reversed / cancelled: the money appeared then vanished, 'my money is gone' after topping up, why was my top-up cancelled, top-up returned by the system, recharged but not credited
criteria.topping_up_by_card: how to top up the account with a card
criteria.transaction_charged_twice: charged twice / duplicate charge for the same transaction
criteria.transfer_fee_charged: a fee was charged for making a transfer; higher fees or fee increases for transfers or for using the account abroad/overseas
criteria.transfer_into_account: how to transfer money into the account, adding money from another bank account
criteria.transfer_not_received_by_recipient: a transfer sent to someone else (recipient, retailer, friend) or within the country has not arrived / hasn't gone through after days / taking too long to complete
criteria.transfer_timing: how long transfers take / how much longer to wait for a transfer / how soon a transfer will arrive (without saying it is pending or missing)
criteria.unable_to_verify_identity: identity verification fails / cannot be completed / rejected
criteria.verify_my_identity: how to verify identity, what is needed/ how to complete identity verification
criteria.verify_source_of_funds: verifying the source of funds / proving where money came from; where the money in the account comes from, how to see the source of the available money (fund flow)
criteria.verify_top_up: verification of a top-up: verification code / 3D-secure / security check needed or not received when topping up or making a card transfer; why verification is needed for a top-up
criteria.virtual_card_not_working: the virtual card does not work
criteria.visa_or_mastercard: whether the card is Visa or Mastercard, choosing between them, asking to get a Visa or Mastercard card
criteria.why_verify_identity: why identity verification is needed / required
criteria.wrong_amount_of_cash_received: received the wrong amount of cash from an ATM (less or more than requested, ATM did not give what was asked although the balance shows it did)
criteria.wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal: wrong or bad exchange rate applied to a cash withdrawal abroad
